instruction.title: VIYA — 정식 인터페이스 기반 및 챕터1 전장 제작 지시서
instruction.scope: Implement A-F in existing project/RunState with temporary graphics; no final/paid/generated artwork or main merge.

tasks.A: Working city lobby, gold/hero info, guarded chapter/stage selection/launch/back/settings, existing Continue/talents/results, readable boss/elite/status HUD. Unimplemented collection/gacha/city/expedition disabled.
tasks.B: MapCatalog and static MapSpace geometry/route cache; per-map world/start/walkable/camera bounds/solids/zones. Existing single RunState owns all combat. Camera clamps at edges; snapshot8 records map ID/view extent.
tasks.C: Prologue trial5000x3200 with solid wall/gate/ruins, arrival area and main lane, temporary geometry. No invented cutscene/dialogue/city health.
tasks.D: Prologue front-only initially; first flank from120, second from240 with main-front weights1 ->4:1 ->2:1:1. General perimeter remains independent. Existing waves/archetypes/30 scatter/old flying events preserved; all new-map members must be off camera and outside solids. Whole groups defer if no valid anchor, never partially commit.
tasks.E: Actual stage2 outskirts_trial4200x2800 with independent perimeter/ruin configuration and same combat code. Historical progress>2 reuses this prototype field without declaring further authored maps or final chapter count.
tasks.F: Technical integration PASS; growth criterion FAIL; device/Windows/performance/human balance NOT_VERIFIED. Native chapter/maps tests, actual scene render/clear-unlock/Continue, original files1-7 in separate processes and20 scripted runs.

implementation.stage_binding: stages.default.map_id=outskirts_trial; override1=prologue_wall; only current GoldProgress.next_stage is launchable, preserving sequential settlement rules. Prior cleared entries are shown completed, future entries locked/preparing.
implementation.legacy_api: Existing3-argument RunState.start retains legacy_arena1800x1200; production UI passes the configured fourth map argument. WORLD_SIZE is a legacy constant, world_size is the actual mapped size. Confirmed restart preserves its current map.
implementation.collision: Player/ground units use swept axis sliding against inflated axis-aligned solids and walkable bounds. Ground routes use visibility graph corners and shared goal-cost cache. Friendly/hostile projectile segments stop at the first wall, including piercing shots. Fliers fly straight over solids and keep ground pushing; existing area magic still crosses cover.
implementation.render: Visible grid/terrain/obstacle/enemy culling; clamped camera with off-center hero at map edges. Read-only actual approach cues grouped by pack, maximum6 groups+2 incoming hostile shots. Cosmetic data reconstructed after recovery.
implementation.hud: Existing two skill rows, supporter2+2 empty slots, touch movement/manual magic, reaction placeholder and safe area retained. Boss current/max HP, elite/boss countdown, separate slow label. Compact bottom204->160 logical pixels; compact magic2lines.
implementation.art: presentation_slots.json ships empty paths; Texture2D or SpriteFrames replacement for city/hero/portrait/archetypes/elite/boss/terrain/skill IDs/magic button. Actual optional skill icon replacement verified with an isolated temporary resource, then removed. No final art generated or approved assets changed.

save.fingerprint: Normalized stages+skills+maps; geometry changes need explicit future compatibility.
save.compatibility: Known1-7 restore as legacy_arena without scaling coordinates or refilling HP/MP/rewriting paid ranks. Version7 keeps existing scatter actors/index/time; older existing1-6 migrations retain their established new-scatter defaults. Unknown/corrupt map/rules/coordinates inside solids rejected.
save.viewport: Saved logical view extent permits exact fixed-size continuation; UI reconstructs current viewport while paused on different-size recovery, preserving resources/actors/offers/RNG. Geometry caches and approach arrows reconstruct, not serialized as separate combat state.

implementation.preserved: 6minutes,120/240 checkpoints,300 boss, elite1600/boss3200, ordinary2/4/6 and55/15/15/15 incl ranged, old20sec/20%30fliers plus12sec30scatter rotation, account18/54 and prices, XP3x/basic5XP, mana40/base1/cooldown0 and account bonuses, existing settlement/choices/pause/art hold.

coverage: UI locked/forged/stale stage launch; Back/settings, actual boss HP/slow, paid result->stage cancel->real talent flow without duplicate reward (includes random boss drop)
Map schema/start/size, camera bounds, actual player wall collision, ground detour to target, both projectile wall paths, airborne straight travel
Perimeter four-direction vs prologue front; whole30 packs off camera/outside terrain, original flying coexistence, bounded real approach cues
Expanded coordinates/map ID/mana restore and30-frame exact continuation across pack event; unknown/inside-solid saves rejected
Existing checkpoints/choice freeze/clear/defeat/settlement/talent suites preserved; optional art wiring and empty production paths checked

render.flow: Actual lobby->stage selection->prologue->real movement/wall/attacks/choices->park/Continue/compact->fixture boss clear/unlock/result->actual general stage->map edge camera->save. Fixture clear verifies routes/settlement, separate20-run measurement below covers natural outcomes. No production gift currency/HP or final art.

balance_measurement.goal: 10-12 meaningful choices remains the original measurement criterion; observed18-28. All4 commands exit1, no target weakened or XP adjusted.
balance_measurement.controller: Same existing controller and5 seeds7/42/143/407/2026 per case, no invulnerability/HP/XP gifts. Map-aware world bounds, no advanced player navigation AI. Default logical view1256x468. Not human balance or causal per-talent comparison; buffed crit/combat timing changes later RNG/positions.
